Vector · version 1

Plan the work. Ship it.

A quiet, precise interface system: near-black canvases, hairline borders lit from the top, and colour only where it means something.

Cards

vx-card for every card and panel. vx-card--accent on one featured card per page.

Cycles

Two-week sprints that roll over unfinished work on their own.

Issues

Fast, keyboard-first tracking with sensible defaults.

Projects

Group issues toward a goal and share progress updates.

Buttons, badges and icon tiles

One primary button per view: on this page it's "Get started" at the top. Badges carry colour only in the dot, so the word carries the meaning.

Icons

vx-ico vx-ico--<name> at 16px in dense UI; add vx-ico--lg for 20px. One hue per object type.
